type.provenance: This Act prohibits the sale of certain products that contain PFAS.

who.provenance: A person may not manufacture, sell, offer for sale or distribute in or into this state a new covered product that contains an intentionally added perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substance.

action.provenance: A person may not manufacture, sell, offer for sale or distribute in or into this state a new covered product that contains an intentionally added perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substance.

value: Outdoor apparel for severe wet conditions
products.provenance: Covered product means any of the following products, including any of the products' components: Aqueous film-forming foam; Artificial turf; Cleaning products; Carpets or rugs; Cookware; Cosmetics; Dental floss; Fabric treatments; Packaging; Juvenile products; Menstrual products; Refrigerators; Textile articles; Ski wax; Outdoor apparel for severe wet conditions.

exceptions.provenance: No specific exceptions are mentioned in the document.

currently_unavoidable.provenance: The document does not mention 'currently unavoidable use'.

intentionally_added.provenance: Intentionally added perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substance is defined as a perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substance found in or on a covered product that serves an intended function in the covered product, is the intended result of a chemical reaction during the manufacture of the covered product, or is a by-product of a process used to manufacture the covered product.
